draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Following up on my note last week — I know new tools often land in a busy week, so no worries if Wrenfield has been on the back burner.

If it's useful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's the natural starting point. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first steps with you and answer anything that's unclear.

Best,
Priya
